messages.content: Your response must include bullet points denoted by * and at least one sub-bullet point denoted by - for each bullet point. Ensure that stop words constitute no more than 27% of the total words in your response. Write a fictional, imaginative, descriptive timeline of an alternate universe where the new world was only discovered in the 1900s with the advent of satellites

message.content:
* 1947 - NASA launches first reconnaissance satellite above North Atlantic
  - Orbital imagery reveals vast landmass obscured centuries by perpetual fog banks
  - Scientists confirm coordinates match ancient Mesoamerican trade routes

* 1949 - Operation Dawnbreak commences
  - Navy aircraft carry first aerial surveys over continental shelf
  - Dense jungle canopy detected via infrared signatures

* 1952 - First ground expedition departs
  - Marine corps team lands on eastern coastline
  - Encounters indigenous civilizations with copper-age metallurgy

* 1955 - Diplomatic contact established
  - Linguists decode click-based phonetic system within six weeks
  - Trade agreements drafted involving obsidian and refined jade

* 1961 - Continental survey completed
  - Satellite mapping reveals three major river systems
  - Estimated population 40 million across twelve distinct cultural zones

* 1968 - First intercontinental flight
  - Boeing 747 prototype crosses Atlantic in record 7 hours
  - Passengers report ghostly aurora-like electromagnetic phenomena

* 1975 - Joint research station established
  - Physicists discover local magnetic field deviates 3.2 degrees
  - Anomaly explains centuries of compass failures in shipping lanes

* 1983 - Cultural exchange program begins
  - Mesoamerican-descended scholars arrive at Cambridge University
  - Their astronomical records predate Ptolemy by two thousand years

* 1991 - Political integration debates intensify
  - UN Security Council deadlocked on sovereignty classification
  - Sister Continent proposal passes 142-38 in General Assembly

* 2003 - Full diplomatic recognition granted
  - Twelve sovereign nations formally admitted to international community
  - Combined GDP projected to reach 3 trillion dollars by 2020
